SDSU's own contact page lists San Diego State University at 5500 Campanile Drive, San Diego, CA, a public university; an MOU/interagency agreement with a Talent/Human Resources department fits a public university partnering on staffing/hiring (e.g., education workforce)

profile.legalName: Trustees of the California State University
profile.summary: San Diego State University is a public research university in San Diego, California. It is one of the campuses of the California State University system, which is governed by the Trustees of the California State University. It offers undergraduate and graduate degrees.

sources.title: Trustees of the California State University

review.notes: The agenda names the Trustees of the California State University acting for San Diego State University, which is the CSU's governing board and its SDSU campus, a public research university that OUSD contracts with for staffing through an interagency MOU. The cited sources support every non-null field: SDSU's contact page gives the website, 619-594-5200, and 5500 Campanile Drive, San Diego, CA 92182; Wikipedia supports the neutral summary and public type; and the CSUN catalog page names the Trustees.
